release_notes.title: Faster Ultracode and more reliable chat
release_notes.summary: Less repeated work, easier Settings and fixes for Notion and screenshots.
added: Updates is back as its own sidebar page.
Settings sections expand and collapse while keeping their title and description visible.
improved: Ultracode uses a 62% smaller instruction pack, reuses verified information and avoids repeated planning and checks. Core skills and verification requirements are preserved.
Workspace pages and the sidebar scroll within the window and use visible theme-matched scrollbars.
The full effort label matches its selected level. Indicators show Ultracode; the Settings dropdown keeps Ultracode (Beta).
fixed: Notion finds send controls in tall composers, ignores hidden old controls and waits for rich-editor controls to become ready.
Large locked Notion tool feedback can use verified small text pastes when native editing and file uploads fail.
Studio screenshots use the Roblox bridge even when AgentScript is selected.
ChatGPT screenshot uploads use one transport, verify a new attachment and commit once. Failed uploads are reported without sending text-only feedback.
notes: Automated checks use production code and browser fixtures. Live signed-in providers and Studio/Blender sessions are not verified. The instruction-size reduction is not a measured provider speedup or benchmark result.

sections.title: ⚡ Faster Ultracode
items: **Less waiting:** a 62% smaller instruction pack, less repeated planning, and reuse of verified information.
**Careful problem solving:** keeps its skills, safety checks and verification.

sections.title: 🖥️ Easier workspace
items: **Scrolling:** reach the bottom of pages, with scrollbars that match your theme.
**Settings:** click a section to open or close it. Updates is back in the sidebar.
**Effort labels:** the whole label matches the level’s color. The bar says Ultracode; Settings keeps Ultracode (Beta).

sections.title: 🔧 Chat and screenshot fixes
items: **Notion:** better send-button detection, including tall composers and delayed startup controls. Large tool replies have a verified text-send fallback.
**Screenshots:** Studio captures use the right bridge. ChatGPT waits for an attachment and sends it once; failed uploads show an error.

release_notes.title: Faster desktop, smaller downloads and a better Explorer
release_notes.summary: Less wasted work, a smaller Windows download and a refreshed workspace.
added: Effort indicators on the desktop and browser bar, with colors from Low through Ultracode.
improved: Unchanged tool lists and logs stay in place instead of rebuilding every second.
MCP listings reuse recent data and share simultaneous requests; hidden windows poll less often.
Explorer has a themed hierarchy, class icons, search and polished script/property panels.
Windows downloads contain the Windows app; Mac has its own complete download.
fixed: Collapsed sidebar icons are centered; pages follow the requested order.
Ultracode changes the selected page outline while preserving the theme glow.
Notion startup can use small verified text pastes when native editing and file uploads fail.
Co-Work leaves idle or disconnected chats available for ordinary messages.
Notion recognizes localized completion controls to avoid waiting after a reply has finished.
A delayed settings read no longer resets a newly selected AgentScript mode.
Windows starts without unnecessary process scans and detects stale agents in any display language.
notes: Automated platform and browser checks passed. Live signed-in providers and Studio sessions remain untested.

sections.title: ⚡ Smoother performance
items: **Less lag:** unchanged tools and logs stay in place. New log lines append without rebuilding the list.
**Less background work:** fewer repeated requests and refreshes while hidden.

sections.title: 📦 Smaller downloads
items: **Windows:** no longer bundles the Mac app and Mac memory helpers. Mac keeps its own complete download. Features and starter skills are preserved.

sections.title: 📁 Better workspace
items: **Explorer:** a cleaner game tree, class icons, search, and script/property panels that match your theme.
**Navigation:** centered collapsed icons and your requested page order. Updates is in Settings.

sections.title: 🧠 See your effort level
items: **Desktop and bar:** show your selected effort. Low starts yellow, Max is red, and Ultracode is purple.
**Ultracode:** selected pages get a purple outline while keeping your theme glow, with a smooth transition.

sections.title: 🔧 Startup and chat fixes
items: **Windows startup:** skips unnecessary process scans and detects old agents across display languages.
**Startup:** another verified text-send path when Notion file uploads fail.
**Normal chat:** idle or disconnected chats no longer turn ordinary messages into queued follow-ups.
**Faster reply detection:** recognize finished responses in more languages, removing avoidable waiting after Notion finishes.
**Engine selection:** a delayed settings load no longer overrides your choice of AgentScript.

release_notes.title: Ultracode, task checklists and smoother creation
release_notes.summary: Follow your AI’s progress, try Ultracode and create with fewer interruptions.
added: Ultracode (Beta) after Max: deeper planning, review and verification when selected.
Show approach summary: an optional paragraph before each command; off by default.
Pinned task checklist with progress and green checks; hide the bar to drag the checklist anywhere.
improved: Shorter, simpler release and update descriptions.
More reliable model and UI creation.
Solar Dusk is now the Default theme; the separate option is removed.
Ultracode smoothly fades purple accents and glow in and out while keeping your theme.
Faster Notion startup when its editor accepts the complete setup text.
fixed: Saved previews insert and export without extra errors.
Editing saved creations no longer causes repeated errors.
Failed updates show the actual error and log location.
Updates handle missing or incomplete saved update settings.
Notion startup handles slow responses and localized editors, and restores typing after cancellation.
notes: Platform checks passed. Live AI chats remain untested; no performance gain is claimed.

github.summary: Follow your AI’s progress, try Ultracode and create with fewer interruptions.

sections.title: 🧠 Ultracode (Beta)
items: **A new option after Max:** asks the AI to plan carefully, review its work and check the result. Turn it on when you want a more thorough approach.

sections.title: ✅ Follow the task
items: **Pinned checklist:** task steps, a progress circle and a percentage above the bar. Finished steps turn green with a check. Hide the bar to turn it into a box you can drag anywhere; hide the checklist separately.
**Show approach summary:** turn on a short explanation before each command. Off by default. This explains the approach; it does not reveal hidden thoughts.

sections.title: 🎨 A fresh look
items: **New Default theme:** the former Solar Dusk look is now built in.
**Purple Ultracode accents:** your theme stays, with purple details that fade smoothly in and out. The checklist matches too.

sections.title: 🛠️ Fewer interruptions
items: **Creation tools:** saved previews, edits and exports work with fewer errors.
**Notion:** better startup recovery, localized chat boxes and typing unlocked after failed starts; fewer unnecessary setup uploads.
**Updates:** handles incomplete update settings and shows the actual reason if installation fails.

sections.title: 🧪 Checks
items: Windows, Mac, Linux and browser checks passed. Live AI chats are not tested; speed and benchmark gains are not guaranteed.

release_notes.title: Reliable results and a browsable Skills page
release_notes.summary: Keep repeated tool results flowing, wait for complete ChatGPT replies, and browse, inspect or add adaptable project skills.
added: A searchable desktop Skills menu with readable names, detailed descriptions, method steps and checks for all 11 starter skills and saved methods.
Add skill and Ask AI to add skill, with generated names for unnamed methods and full paginated starter instructions.
improved: Skills are applied by inspecting project context, adapting relevant methods and verifying behavior. AI-created candidates stay unverified until checked.
fixed: Identical results from separate command turns are now delivered independently. Only the same confirmed delivery is deduplicated.
ChatGPT output pauses no longer finalize a command while the native Stop control is present; a stuck reply pauses safely without auto-stopping the AI.
CodeMirror command text refreshes after same-length replacements.
notes: Automated fixtures and platform checks cover these cases; live signed-in provider conversations remain untested. Windows remains unsigned.

github.summary: Reliable tool-result delivery and a searchable Skills page.
added: Browse all 11 starter skills and saved methods; click for details and read full starter instructions.
Add a skill manually or ask AI to name and describe one.
improved: Adapt skills to the current game’s systems and constraints.
fixed: Equal results from new commands are delivered; confirmed retries are coalesced.
Wait for ChatGPT’s native completion; refresh equal-length code edits.
notes: Fixture/platform validation included. Live signed-in provider chats remain untested.

release_notes.title: Starter skills, automatic learning and reliable updates
release_notes.summary: Start with 11 Roblox skills, reuse privacy-safe workflow methods automatically and prevent oversized update feeds.
added: Eleven bundled SyphoDev Roblox starter skills, with complete instructions, references and helpers. Relevant skills are matched automatically; users can add their own methods.
Automatic retrieval and contribution of predefined local edit workflows after recorded test commands. Offline reports queue locally without prompts, code, paths or user identifiers.
improved: Shared learning is always active; local free-text candidates remain private and separate manual contributions still require review.
fixed: Fixed “Release feed is too large” for existing installations. Feeds retain five recent entries with a byte budget; the full changelog remains separate.
macOS background launches apply window state after desktop startup; agent and updater logs stay outside the signed app bundle.
notes: Workflow reports do not train provider model weights or prove benchmark gains. Unsupported workflows remain local. Live signed-in providers and Studio/Blender are untested; Windows remains unsigned.

github.summary: 11 Roblox starter skills, automatic privacy-safe workflow reuse and reliable updates.
added: 11 SyphoDev Roblox starter skills, full references and helpers; add your own anytime.
Always-active shared workflows with bounded reports and offline retry.
improved: Private prompts, code, paths and identifiers stay local.
fixed: Oversized update feeds blocked older installations; compact feeds now have a release gate.
macOS background window state and logs outside the signed app bundle.
notes: Workflow reuse does not train model weights. No benchmark gain claimed. See ZIP validation.
